html: † מַרְדּוּת n.f. rebellion, rebelliousness, only in בֶּן־נַעֲוַת המ׳ 1 S 20:30, where read prob. בֶּן־נַעֲרַת הַמַּרְדוּת son of a girl of rebelliousness=rebellious girl, cf. 𝔊 𝔙 Th We Dr HPS; > LagM i. 236 f. Bu (cf. also Dr Kit) der. מ׳ from רדה, and, retaining MT, read a woman gone astray (v. II. עָוָה) from discipline (Aramaic sense: √ רְדָא).
